Basics

Oil on the plate

Olaj a végén

6 months+ Adjusted 5 min 1 portion

From 6 months, as a teaspoon on food the child is already eating. This is not a drink, and it is not a jar of garlic oil.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (stirred into the finished plate)
  • 1 tsp optional flaxseed oil (only from a small fridge jar used within two weeks; never heated)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Cook the meal without a special blended baby oil.
  2. Stir one teaspoon of rapeseed or olive oil into the cooked plate.
  3. If you use flaxseed oil, keep only a small jar in the fridge and finish it within two weeks.
  4. Add flaxseed oil after cooking and never heat it.
  5. Do not steep garlic or herbs in oil.

Adjusted

A special baby oil blend is unnecessary, and infused oil is a botulism risk.

Skip the 500 ml bottle of mixed oils in the cupboard and stir a teaspoon of rapeseed or olive oil into the cooked plate. If you use flaxseed oil, keep a small jar in the fridge, finish it within two weeks, and never heat it. Do not steep garlic or herbs in oil.
